title: Man with Crescent Moon Head
description: A surreal painting depicts a man in a grey sweater sitting and reading a book with mathematical equations, his head replaced by a glowing yellow crescent moon. To the left, a giant grey anthropomorphic moon face with yellow eyes has multiple people sitting on its craters, while blue butterflies float throughout a swirling pink and blue vortex background containing an elderly man in a green sweater and stylized faces.
prompt: Surreal symbolic painting of a man sitting in a chair reading an open book filled with equations, his head replaced by a glowing yellow crescent moon emitting light. To the left a giant smiling anthropomorphic moon with yellow eyes has various people sitting on its surface. Blue butterflies swirl around them. An elderly man sits in an armchair nearby. Vibrant swirling pink, teal, and blue vortex background with stylized faces and colorful spirals.
